purpose: To apply to the Regional Director to get empanelled as a mediator or conciliator under the Companies (Mediation and Conciliation) Rules, 2016.
who: A person who intends to get empanelled as mediator or conciliator and possesses the requisite qualifications.
when: Every year during the month of February when applications are invited, or within 60 days from the publication of rules for FY 2016-17.
steps: Verify that you possess the requisite qualifications specified in Rule 4.
Wait for the Regional Director to invite applications during the month of February every year.
Apply to the Regional Director in Form MDC-1.
checklist: Ensure you intend to get empanelled as a mediator or conciliator.
Verify you possess the requisite qualifications specified in Rule 4.
watch: Applications are typically invited every year during the month of February.
